reproduction.expected: A concrete ChatGPT/Codex Host installation durably ingests a provider event, binds it to the exact active external wait, and performs one idempotent wake-up of the same Host session and TaskRun.
reproduction.actual: The Host exposes only the manual RESUME_EXTERNAL transport operation. No concrete event inbox, exact-wait matcher, atomic delivery reservation, one-shot scheduler, crash recovery receipt, or initializer wiring exists.

violated_invariants: External wait must yield and later resume from one durable matching event without a polling loop.
A duplicate or concurrent event delivery must not resume the same wait twice.
Scheduler and external events must not gain write, Quality, completion, release, production, or merge authority.
